programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity.

programme.title: The Change-Up
programme.desc: Once inseparable pals, Dave (Jason Bateman) and Mitch (Ryan Reynolds) have drifted apart over the years. Dave is an overworked lawyer and family man, while Mitch has thus far avoided most of the normal responsibilities of adulthood. Each is envious of the other's life, and following a drunken binge, the men awake to find they have somehow switched bodies. Dave and Mitch soon discover that things are not as rosy as they seemed and try to find a way to return their lives to normal.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le 5 septembre 2012, une voiture est retrouvée criblée de balles sur un parking de la Combe d'Ire, en Haute-Savoie. Un cycliste savoyard du nom de Sylvain Mollier, un touriste britannique du nom de Saad al-Hilli, ainsi que sa femme et sa belle-mère, ont été assassinés. Seules leurs deux fillettes ont survécu.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: En décembre 2008, Stéphane Kameugne, 24 ans, étudiant à l'Ecole des Arts et Métiers de Châlons-en-Champagne, disparaît après la soirée de gala annuelle de remise des diplômes. Il est retrouvé noyé le 24 décembre. Une information est ouverte pour homicide volontaire, mais le crime n'a jamais été élucidé.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Mercredi 21 mars 2007, Christian Maréchal, chef de la police municipale de Chambourcy, est découvert gisant dans une mare de sang dans l'entrée de son pavillon. Il a reçu 18 coups de couteau. Qui pouvait en vouloir à ce père de famille respecté ? La police épuise toutes les pistes dont elle dispose.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Perpignan, juillet 2013. Francisco Benitez, un légionnaire, signale la disparition de sa femme, Marie-Josée, et de sa fille, Allison. Peu de temps après Francisco Benitez est retrouvé pendu dans sa caserne, le visage cagoulé. La Police Judiciaire de Montpellier va ouvrir une enquête autour d'une question : Francisco Benitez a-t-il tué femme et enfant avant de se donner la mort ?

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: En avril 2007, Gaëlle Fosset, 21 ans, est retrouvée morte chez elle à Saint-Germain-la-Campagne, en Normandie. La jeune femme a reçu 66 coups de couteau. Les enquêteurs ont le sentiment qu'elle a volontairement ouvert la porte à son agresseur. Mais aucun élément tangible ne permet d'élucider ce meurtre.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le 4 août 1997, le corps de Christian Jambert, gendarme retraité, est découvert à Auxerre. Une carabine 22 Long Rifle est posée sur ses jambes. Le médecin appelé pour constater le décès conclut au suicide. Des années plus tard, ses enfants font rouvrir l'affaire. L'homme a visiblement été assassiné.

Pas kthimit nga SHBA, ai i kushton jetën babait dhe motrave të cilat vuajnë nga probleme fiziologjike, si pasojë tragjike e traumave të tyre të fëmijërisë dhe historisë familjare. I izoluar nga çdo aktivitet shoqëror rastesisht takon Incin dhe menjëherë bie në dashuri me të. Për herë të parë në jetën e tij, do të kërkojë lumturinë!

programme.title: Beşiktaş - Hapoel Beerşeba - UEFA Avrupa Ligi Grup Maçları
programme.desc: Liga e Evropës e UEFA-s është një kompeticion vjetor i futbollit për klube, i organizuar që nga viti 1971 nga UEFA për klubet evropiane të kualifikueshme. Është kompeticioni i nivelit të dytë i futbollit evropian për klube, duke u renditur poshtë Ligës së Kampionëve të UEFA-s dhe mbi Ligën e Konferencës të UEFA-s. I prezantuar në vitin 1971 si Kupa UEFA, ai zëvendësoi Kupën e Panaireve Ndërqytetëse. Kompeticioni mori emrin e tij aktual në vitin 2009, pas një ndryshimi të formatit që përfshinte një bashkim me Kupën Intertoto të UEFA-s, duke zgjeruar fazën e grupeve dhe duke ndryshuar kualifikimin. Në sezonin 2024–25, faza e grupeve u zëvendësua nga një fazë lige me 36 ekipe. Fituesit e Ligës së Evropës të UEFA-s kualifikohen për Superkupën e UEFA-s dhe Ligën e Kampionëve të UEFA-s të sezonit pasardhës.

programme.title: ÇSKA Sofya - Trabzonspor - UEFA Konferans Ligi Grup Maçları
programme.desc: Liga e Konferencës e UEFA-s është një kompeticion ndërkombëtar i përvitshëm futbolli për klube meshkujsh, i organizuar nga UEFA, që përbën nivelin e tretë të futbollit evropian për klube, pas Ligës së Kampionëve dhe Ligës së Evropës të UEFA-s. I themeluar në vitin 2021, turneu mbledh klube nga e gjithë Evropa që garojnë për një trofe të rëndësishëm kontinental. Kompeticioni përfshin raunde kualifikuese, të ndjekura nga një fazë lige me 36 skuadra, ku secili klub luan gjashtë ndeshje kundër kundërshtarëve të ndryshëm, përpara se të kalohet në ndeshjet e fazës play-off dhe raundet me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë. Turneu kulmon me një finale të vetme që përcakton kampionin, i cili siguron gjithashtu kualifikimin në Ligën e Evropës të UEFA-s për sezonin pasardhës.

Smaki świata po polsku
programme.desc: Ola Nguyen to mistrzyni kuchni, dzieciństwo spędziła w Wietnamie, a nad Wisłę przyjechała w wieku 7 lat. Pomaga jej Robert El Gendy, który urodził się na Mazurach, ale płynie w nim egipska krew. Któż lepiej niż ten duet zgłębi kuchnię?

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Nad rozlewiskiem ogólny smutek, trwają przygotowania do pogrzebu Kaśki. Małgosia jest załamana, a do tego musi zająć się wszystkimi pod nieobecność Basi. Rysio załamany po nieudanych urodzinach postanawia razem z Bronią uciec z domu.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Po śmierci Kasi Basia postanawia znowu opuścić rozlewisko. Wyjeżdża do Indii, by odnaleźć duchowy spokój. Krzysztof zdecydował - nie wyjedzie do Szczytna. Postanawia związać życie z Marysią i coraz lepiej czuje się w roli przyszłego ojca.

programme.title: Bartoszewski. Siła przebaczenia
programme.desc: Film przedstawia życie i dziedzictwo Władysława Bartoszewskiego, historyka, dyplomaty, pisarza i świadka historii, którego życie było świadectwem mocy człowieczeństwa w obliczu tragedii. Narracja ukazuje Bartoszewskiego nie tylko jako świadka historii, ale przede wszystkim jako człowieka, który konsekwentnie odrzucał nienawiść. Film podkreśla, że przebaczenie - choć trudne - było dla niego nie akt

programme.title: Zakochaj się w Polsce
programme.desc: Tomasz Bednarek w swojej podróży po Polsce odwiedza Głuchołazy, miasto tuż obok czeskiej granicy, z niezwykłą Parkową Górą i tężnią solankową. Głuchołazy szczycą się też bogatą historią wydobycia złota. Do miasta zjeżdżają rowerzyści.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Podczas wizyty Huberta w szpitalu Adam wysuwa pod adresem rodziny Pyrków oskarżenia o zlecenie ataku i domaga się korzyści majątkowej w zamian za milczenie. Informacja o radykalnych działaniach Daniela wywołuje u Asi głęboki wstrząs.

programme.title: Tańcząca ze światem
programme.desc: Program lifestylowo-podróżniczy, w którym prowadząca, Edyta Herbuś, pokazuje życie mieszkańców innych krajów, ich tradycje, kulturę, obyczaje oraz lokalne tańce. Edyta Herbuś odkryje przed widzami uroki i tajemnice Jordanii.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Krótkie reportaże o charakterze edukacyjnym prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. Miejsca skrywające wiele tajemnic, owiane legendą, miejsca o bogatej historii. W tym odcinku: Osiedle Boernerowo.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Do Wilkowyj dociera jedna z plag współczesnego świata - mafia. Konkretnie dociera dwoma czarnymi bmw, pełnymi ubranych w dresy młodzieńców o byczych karkach. Wilkowyjskie centra biznesu padają ofiarą brutalnego szantażu.

programme.title: Ekstradycja
programme.desc: W Ośrodku Integracji Europejskiej odbywa się tajne spotkanie ministra z zagranicznymi partnerami. Uczestniczy w nim Fiduk. Halski z Wojtkiem umieszczają podsłuch w sali obrad. Następnego dnia Wojtek znika w tajemniczych okolicznościach, a wraz z nim - taśma z nagraniem poufnej konferencji.

programme.title: Sterk - znaczy silny
programme.desc: Film dokumentalny o Polakach mieszkających w Norwegii. Jego celem jest przedstawienie doświadczeń i trudów emigracji na podstawie historii pięciu bohaterów.

programme.title: Rodzinka.pl
programme.desc: Podczas kolejnej kolacji u Boskich Viola i Marek grają pierwsze skrzypce. Tomek jest zazdrosny o Magdę, postanawia więc bliżej poznać ojca Dianki. Dochodzi do konfrontacji Pauli z Kacprem. Współpraca Ludwika i Agaty wchodzi na kolejny poziom.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: W drodze na rekolekcje do sąsiedniej parafii, ojciec Mateusz zauważa taksówkę stojącą na niebezpiecznym przejeździe kolejowym. Okazuje się, że kierowca uległ tajemniczemu zatruciu. Poszkodowany następnego dnia znika ze szpitala.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: Tragiczne wydarzenie, związane z jednym z wychowanków sandomierskiego liceum, zwraca uwagę wszystkich na trudne relacje panujące między uczniami. Zwłaszcza jedna z uczennic, Zuzanna, bardzo cierpi z powodu docinków i drwin rówieśników.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Karol Stefan Szolc - Rogoziński u schyłku 1881 r. wystąpił z ros. marynarki wojennej, wrócił w rodzinne strony. W Polsce zaprezentował plan ekspedycji do Kamerunu. Zdobył ok. 370 okazów. Są w Muzeum Etnograficznym w Krakowie i w Warszawie.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Podczas wizyty Huberta w szpitalu Adam wysuwa pod adresem rodziny Pyrków oskarżenia o zlecenie ataku i domaga się korzyści majątkowej w zamian za milczenie. Informacja o radykalnych działaniach Daniela wywołuje u Asi głęboki wstrząs.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Bohaterem tego odcinka jest August Zamoyski - polski rzeźbiarz działający w Brazylii i Francji.

programme.title: Makłowicz w podróży
programme.desc: Makłowicz podróżuje po Tunezji, a ściślej wokół miasta Monastyr. Ciekawy jest port rybacki Teboulba, z którego Robert wypływa kutrem, by zobaczyć hodowlę ryb na pełnym morzu.

programme.title: Skarbiec sztuki Lubelszczyzny
programme.desc: Według legendy powstał w roku 1434, kiedy to gdański kupiec Henryk próbował ukraść lubelską relikwię drzewa Krzyża Świętego z kościoła oo. dominikanów.

programme.title: Korona Gór Polski
programme.desc: Tematem odcinka będzie Tarnica, najwyższy szczyt polskich Bieszczadów, zachwycający rozległymi panoramami, dziką przyrodą i niepowtarzalnym klimatem bieszczadzkich połonin.

programme.title: Pięknie przyprawiONA
programme.desc: Mrożenie jest najzdrowszym sposobem przechowywania żywności. Zamrożone produkty nie tracą właściwości odżywczych i nie zawierają konserwantów, a kończący się okres letni i rozkwitający czas jesieni to najlepszy okres na przygotowanie aromatycznych i pełnych witamin zapasów w naszej zamrażarce. W programie dowiemy się, jak gotować z wykorzystaniem mrożonek, tak by wydobyć z nich aromat pełnych słoń

programme.title: Profesor Michałowski. Droga do Faras
programme.desc: Historia najwybitniejszego polskiego archeologa, prof. Kazimierza Michałowskiego i jego największego odkrycia w Faras. Bez jego determinacji i pasji nie byłoby polskiej archeologii z jej międzynarodowymi sukcesami i pozycją, jaką ma dziś.

programme.title: Na dobre i na złe
programme.desc: Doktor Jakubek na dyżurze nagle zaczyna tak źle się czuć, że przerywa pracę przekonany, że ma zawał. Oliwa zostaje sama na placu boju i musi przez to samodzielnie wykonać ryzykowną operację u kobiety z poważnym urazem wątroby.

programme.title: Na sygnale
programme.desc: Wiktor próbuje na nowo porozumieć się z Czarkiem, a w pracy zespół doktora Banacha trafia na starszego, zdezorientowanego mężczyznę, który błąka się w nocy po ulicy i u którego lekarz diagnozuje krwotok wewnętrzny.

programme.title: Na sygnale
programme.desc: Basia i Dobromir planują swoje "rozstanie" - na przyjęciu z okazji rocznicy Lisickich. W pracy muszą pomóc dziewczynie, która o mało nie utonęła w basenie. Z kolei Britney z Alkiem próbują uratować chłopca, który stracił nagle przytomność.

programme.title: Zmiennicy
programme.desc: Przed sądem stają oskarżeni o porwanie taksówki strażak Kuśmider i Krashan. Sprawa narkotyków jest niejasna, oskarżeni łżą jak z nut, a świadkowie plączą się w zeznaniach. W efekcie Kuśmider i Krashan otrzymują wyrok w zawieszeniu.

programme.title: Close Your Eyes Before It's Dark:13
programme.desc: 一封突如其來的簡訊，將闊別多年的八位好友齊聚山中民宿，預備一同挖出學生時代埋下的時空膠囊，沒想卻讓一樁昔日醜聞意外出土，使心結與宿怨逐漸淹沒了理智。第一具屍體的出現，象徵純潔的友誼就此告終；第二具屍體的出現，宣告殺人遊戲正式啟動。風雨阻斷逃生去路，死亡數目逐漸升高。在人人自危的時刻，不願扣下扳機的那個人，也許就是下一具屍體......。

programme.desc: Dieciocho villanos icónicos compiten por el título de "El Emperador de los Villanos" y 200 mil dólares. Entre desafíos, inmunidades, alianzas y traiciones, solo uno alcanza la cima.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Odio y desalojo; The Gold Digger
programme.desc: Quiere desalojarlos por conflictivos, ellos creen que los discrimina. Mirela llega a un acuerdo con José para quedarse con la pensión de su padre, pero el plan se cae cuando aparece la viuda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La recompensa; Bendito sea mi padre
programme.desc: Una mujer quiere obtener la recompensa que ofrecen por su marido, un ladrón prófugo de la justicia. Por otro lado, Marina se entera de que un cura ha demostrado ser su padre. Por si fuera poco, este obtuvo su custodia y planea llevársela a Panamá.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Johnny sufre un accidente tras enterarse de que uno de sus hijos no es suyo. Simón y Dolores están en pleno acto sexual, cuando el esposo de ella los sorprende, le mutila el miembro al amante.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: El camión está listo para cargar toda la mercancía. Abel, el Pastor, advierte que no es el mismo de siempre y Lidia se pone nerviosa. Roxana y sus aliadas le siguen la pista con el rastreador.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: Ferrer enfrenta el interrogatorio y se quiebra al recordar a David. No sabe dónde lo trasladarán. Carmen y Manuel son sus únicos aliados. Roxana usa su poder para ubicarlo donde más le conviene.

programme.title: La Doña
programme.desc: La expropiación ya es noticia. Saúl, enfurecido, busca a Altagracia y le dice que su estrategia funcionó, enamorarlo para que él baje la guardia. Se besan y Felipe los sorprende in fraganti.

programme.title: La Doña
programme.desc: Saúl despierta del coma, junto a Altagracia, y jura venganza contra Felipe. La Doña lo disuade. Miguel Preciado reconoce a uno de sus cómplices, un coronel. Valeria seduce a Lopecito.

programme.title: Victoria
programme.desc: Victoria disfruta una agradable velada en casa de Jerónimo. Él comparte con ella detalles sobre su pasado y ella le habla de sus sueños y deseos, pero una visita inesperada arruina el momento.

programme.title: Victoria
programme.desc: Victoria decide confesarle a su hijo Santiago todo lo que pasa con Jerónimo y él la apoya. Por su parte, Enrique se muda al departamento de Tatiana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Señalan a Juan de participar en el secuestro y muerte de una parte de la familia de Abel. Debby subasta el agua de unos baños que se dio y su amigo Josué le exige la mitad del dinero ganado.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.desc: Tras decir la verdad, Alex es víctima de la intolerancia. Aunque todos sospechan quiénes fueron, no hay pruebas de la agresión. Remedios busca refugio en otro lado, de inmediato.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.desc: La congelación de óvulos de Gloria trae otra discusión entre Plutarco y Constanza. Despierta interés y hasta preocupación por los hijos que quieran tener, si se enamoran otra vez.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.desc: La cosa se pone color de hormiga. No todos están dispuestos a hacer lo que no quieren. A Emiliano le cuesta abrir la puerta, a Plutarco responder una propuesta y a Susi entender quién es Nico.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.desc: La confidencialidad se va al diablo. Roger ventila detalles de los Quinteros en televisión. Se desata una discusión sin precedentes. Plutarco pide el video de vigilancia, la prueba del delito.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.desc: Plutarco, Remedios y Constanza enfrentan con pruebas a los mentirosos que los engañaron y cada uno toma una decisión que marca sus vidas. Roger intenta enmendar su traición.

programme.title: Juego de villanos
programme.desc: Luca, Arleth y Caniggia se juegan la permanencia, mientras Lis está satisfecha con la condena, aunque quiere más y centra su atención en Nahomi. Un invitado muy especial llega a la Villa.

programme.title: Juego de villanos
programme.desc: Nahomi, Mayer y Lis buscan redimirse en una prueba donde el equilibrio decide quién sobrevive. Alicia mueve sus fichas por conveniencia y evalúa cambiar de bando. Siete villanos quedan en pie.

programme.title: Juego de villanos
programme.desc: Los villanos afrontan un reto individual de fuerza y dos rivales miden su poder. Se activan los pactos, pero todo tiene un precio. Un maletín misterioso llega a la Villa. Nada queda al azar.

programme.title: Brigadoon
programme.desc: Tommy Albright (Gene Kelly) and Jeff Douglas (Van Johnson), two American pals on a Scottish hunting trip, get lost in the woods and come upon the magical village of Brigadoon. Rising out of the Scottish mist only once every 100 years, and only for one day, Brigadoon is an enchanted place where life is simpler and easier, untouched by the worries of the modern world. When Tommy falls for beautiful villager Fiona Campbell (Cyd Charisse), he must decide whether to stay or to return to his life.

programme.title: Annie Get Your Gun
programme.desc: The musical tale of Annie Oakley (Betty Hutton) moves from stage to screen in this rollicking film adaptation. Renowned in the Wild West as a sharpshooter, Annie meets her match, both romantically and professionally, in the form of fellow ace gunslinger Frank Butler (Howard Keel). While Annie and Frank are performing as part of the famous traveling show headlined by the legendary Buffalo Bill (Louis Calhern), the two compete and flirt, with plenty of ups and downs along the way.

programme.title: Seven Brides for Seven Brothers
programme.desc: During the 1850s, Milly (Jane Powell), a pretty young cook, marries Adam (Howard Keel), a grizzled woodsman, after a brief courtship. When the two return to Adam's farm, Milly is shocked to meet his six ill-mannered brothers, all of whom live in his cabin. She promptly begins teaching the brothers proper behavior, and most importantly, how to court a woman. But after the brothers kidnap six local girls during a town barn-raising, a group of indignant villagers tries to track them down.

programme.title: Meet Me in St. Louis
programme.desc: "Meet Me in St. Louis" is a classic MGM romantic musical comedy that focuses on four sisters (one of whom is the nonpareil Judy Garland) on the cusp of the 1904 St. Louis World's Fair. The film spotlights the sisters' education in the ways of the world, which includes, but isn't limited to, learning about life and love, courtesy of the prototypical boy next door. In the end, love -- accompanied by song, dance and period costumes, all in glorious Technicolor -- conquers all.

programme.title: My Fair Lady

His subject turns out to be the lovely Eliza Doolittle (Audrey Hepburn), who agrees to speech lessons to improve her job prospects. Higgins and Eliza clash, then form an unlikely bond -- one that is threatened by an aristocratic suitor (Jeremy Brett).

programme.title: Lili

Though she becomes infatuated with the dashing magician, Marcus the Magnificent (Jean-Pierre Aumont), Lili forms a more significant bond with puppeteer Paul (Mel Ferrer) and his four puppets, which she treats as real people. Together, Lili, Paul and the puppets prove to be a popular act, but their success and happiness are threatened by Paul's gruffness.

programme.title: Andy Hardy Meets Debutante

Andy immediately forgets about Polly Benedict (Ann Rutherford), his girlfriend back home, and falls head over heels for Daphne. But as he starts to rub elbows with trendy Manhattanites, he begins to long for Polly -- and he soon realizes that the big city lacks the charms of his small hometown.

programme.title: Andy Hardy's Private Secretary

However, all Andy can think about is participating in school clubs. When his workload simply gets too heavy, he has the bright idea to enlist the attractive Kathryn (Kathryn Grayson) to be his receptionist, which makes his girlfriend, Polly (Ann Rutherford), jealous. Unfortunately, Andy will need both Kathryn and Polly to help him if he is to pass his dreaded English test.

programme.title: Hail the Conquering Hero
programme.desc: Like his war-hero father who was killed in action during World War I, Woodrow Lafayette Pershing Truesmith leaves his small town to join the Marines during World War II. But when he's given a medical discharge after only a month, he takes a job at a San Diego shipyard and writes letters to his mother about his fictitious wartime exploits. When he returns home, he discovers that his innocent lies have spread further than he expected.

programme.title: The Great McGinty
programme.desc: In a dive south of the border, bartender Dan McGinty (Brian Donlevy) stops a young man from committing suicide after a moment of dishonesty, and relates how a moment of honesty brought him down in a flashback. As a young man, McGinty joins a crooked political boss and rises from extortionist to alderman. Urged by the boss to marry his secretary to give respectability to his run for mayor, McGinty agrees -- only to fall in love with his wife and decide to do an honest thing for once in his life.

programme.title: Christmas in July

To everyone's surprise, the coffee company owner, Dr. Maxford (Raymond Walburn), also falls for the prank and awards the prize check to Jimmy. Eventually the ruse is discovered, jeopardizing Jimmy and Betty's newfound happiness.

programme.title: The Palm Beach Story

Gerry decides to leave Tom, a struggling architect, and head to Palm Beach in order to marry a wealthy man who could fund Tom's projects. When Tom follows Gerry, they cross paths with the quirky millionaire John D. Hackensacker III (Rudy Vallee) and his chatty, husband-seeking sister, Princess Centimillia (Mary Astor).

programme.title: The Lady Eve

When Charles suspects Jean is a gold digger, he dumps her. Jean, fixated on revenge and still pining for the millionaire, devises a plan to get back in Charles' life. With love and payback on her mind, she re-introduces herself to Charles, this time as an aristocrat named Lady Eve Sidwich.

programme.title: Sullivan's Travels

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.7
programme.desc: "Seoyeong visits her mother's hometown to bury her ashes and runs into Ujae who secretly followed her. Meanwhile Hojeong continues to do what she can to try and get Sangu's attention whilst Seoyeong's dad runs into trouble again and his daughter finally confronts him about why she hates him. In the end Ujae's mother discovers the photos that Ujae took of Seoyeong and the family go into an interrogation about Seoyeong's background. The heartbreaking and ardent love of Lee Sam-jae, Seo-young's father, for his daughter is depicted in this weekend drama, highlighting the preciousness of parental love. It teaches us that family is interconnected not only by blood but also by love."

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.8
programme.desc: Samjae continues to work hard as a hall manager to save money and face but ends up at the police station much to Seoyeong's disappointment. Hojeong gets busted for being in love which will lead to dire consequences for her. Seongjae finds out what's been going on with his brother and his tutor and why she has to quit. He relieves his stress the only way he knows how... Which is to go on a shopping spree... Just like his mother. Migyeong finds out the truth behind her boyfriend and Ujae gives up on Seoyeong in the end.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.9
programme.desc: Ujae's mother goes on a hunger strike to try and prevent Ujae's marriage but in the end she strikes a deal that forces Seoyeong to back away. Ujae's at his wits end because he's done everything he can to win Seoyeong's heart. He knows she loves him and her pride and fear are keeping her away. In the end he decides that he can't do anything for her and leaves for the U.S. Meanwhile Hojeong tried desperately to meet Sangu one last time to return his handkerchief only to discover that his father's sick. She ends up nursing him and gets to see Sangu who confirms that he doesn't like her but doesn't hate her either. This is good enough for her.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.10
programme.desc: Seoyeong is determined to maintain her lie about going overseas. There is no way she can confess to Ujae that she lied about her father. Sangu is distraught at her decision but can't help her out. There is no way that he can disown his father no matter how much he has hated him too. In the midst of this Hojeong agrees to go to the U.S. with the promise that after she returns she can do whatever she wants. In the end Samjae goes to be a pretend guest at a VIP's wedding... The twist is shocking!

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.11
programme.desc: It's been 3 years since the last episode... Jiseon has a hard time adjusting to her perfect daughter-in-law... What every other mother-in-law would be happy about, she finds a burden and complains to Gapsun. Meanwhile Hojeong returns from the U.S., bringing back a man with her that she's sure her mother will accept. Migyeong is now dating Sangu and considering marriage whilst Seoyeong has to handle a major case and continues to grow weary of being a judge. Samjae is the one who is truly doing well with himself, having paid of his debts and worked hard to become a decent father. Perhaps he hopes for the day he'll be reunited with his daughter.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.12
programme.desc: Marriage troubles continue between Ujae's parents as their wedding anniversary comes by. Seoyeong gets scouted by Unique Law Firm after the sentencing of her murder trial. She finds it harder by the day to work as a judge. Meanwhile Samjae is continuing to work hard and Sangu's love for Migyeong is deepening. She's worried about telling him the truth whilst Hojeong does what she can to gain some independence from her overly attached mother.

programme.title: Franklin and Friends
programme.desc: "Franklin and Friends," based on the children's book series featuring Franklin, is a computer-animated series geared toward preschoolers that aims to teach the kids lessons. The series follows Franklin the turtle, now older than in the books and previous TV series, as he experiences adventures and achieves milestones in the community of Woodland, learning lessons along the way. Franklin's friends referenced in the title include best friend Bear, problem-solving Snail, practical joker Rabbit, natural leader Beaver, inventive Fox and empathetic Goose. The series tackles issues that include personal empowerment, socialization, self-esteem, appreciation of nature and school issues.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: With the Dolittle, and other Baby programs under their belts, the tots who follow Julie Aigner-Clark's Baby Einstein series will sidle up to Baby Newton expecting a similar exploration of building blocks to brilliance, but this time there's a wrinkle or two. Animation makes its first appearance, and parents steeped in keep-it-simple culture may object to the springy "I Know My Shapes" song, a departure from classical-only video predecessors.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: My First Signs: See and Sign With Baby
programme.desc: As babies grow, their eye-hand coordination begins to improve as their ability to interact with their surroundings blossoms. It is the perfect time for My First Signs, A playful introduction to 20 common words and phrases from baby's world -- including ''mommy'', ''daddy'' and ''I love you'' -- both Spoken and in Sign Language.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Early on in babies' development, they begin to recognize primary colors such as blue, red, and yellow. And all the while, they're also processing an infinite variety of new sights and sounds. Think of the joy you'll experience as you introduce your little one to beautiful music and imagery with Baby Beethoven Symphony of Fun.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: At 12 months, babies can identify specific sounds, and they re also starting to match the sounds they hear with the objects that make them. Meet the Orchestra -- First Instruments presents your little "maestro" with a playful introduction to the sights and sounds of a real orchestra -- from the clashing of cymbals to the purring of the cello and everything in between!

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: Baby Einstein: Let's Learn About Animals Around the World
programme.desc: Meet fascinating animals from across the globe! Dance and sing along with puppets and discover some of the world's most unique creatures. Join us to dance along to classical melodies as we learn animal names through narration and repetition or simply enjoy seeing live-action footage.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: Baby Einstein: Let's Learn about Classical Music
programme.desc: Discover instruments through narration and repetition. Real-life images and sounds will engage viewers as they dance to upbeat classical favorites from Beethoven, Mozart and more. Join your favorite Baby Einstein characters to discover what makes each instrument unique!

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: Baby MacDonald: A Day On the Farm
programme.desc: As little ones' curiosity about the world blossoms, you can help sow the seeds of discovery with Baby MacDonald: A Day on the Farm. Featuring live-action images, nursery rhymes and fun-filled puppet shows, this playful, interactive program introduces little ones to the exciting sights and sounds of a real working farm.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Cal, Neptune, Opus, Dean, Tinker and others learn about the flora and fauna of the ocean through STEAM-based principles and real-life footage.

programme.title: The Sandbox
programme.desc: The Sandbox is where our favorite Baby Einstein characters gather to play, problem-solve and have fun. Each five-minute episode explores an area of curiosity relevant to our 2-4 year old audience. Since the four weathered planks of wood that make up the structure of their sandbox are no obstacles for their imaginations, the entire universe is available to them for each new adventure.

programme.title: Manners Manor
programme.desc: Introducing "Manners Manor," a new series from Baby Einstein. Designed to help your child learn all about manners in a fun and thoughtful way. The content is based on "The Einstein Way" - a curiosity-driven learning philosophy, from industry experts, inspired by Montessori and STEAM. It also reflects our core belief that curiosity is the most important skill for our kids to learn in order to be successful and adaptable in an ever-changing world.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: On the Go: Riding, Sailing and Soaring
programme.desc: As little ones become increasingly mobile, their fascination with all things that move intensifies too. On the Go: Riding, Sailing and Soaring exposes babies to the different ways people travel -- on land, by sea, and in the air -- while it presents them with captivating real-world images, funny puppet shows, and beautiful classical music by Beethoven, Haydn, Mozart and Rossini.

programme.title: The Killers
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring The Killers.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood
programme.sub-title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: Rod Stewart
programme.desc: A concert by the legendary Rod Stewart, that closed Radio 2's Annual Festival In A Day, held in September 2015 in London's Hyde Park.

programme.title: Electric Light Orchestra
programme.desc: Captured live at London's Wembley Arena and directed by Mike Mansfield this space-age show will live forever in rock history as, quite literally, out of this world featuring a pioneering laser display, the first of its kind that set a precedent for subsequent rock shows. 'Standing in the Rain', 'Night in The Rain', 'Turn to Stone', 'Tight Rope', 'Telephone Line', 'Rock Aria', 'Wild West Hero', 'Show Down', 'Sweet Talking Woman', 'Roll Over Beethoven'.

programme.title: Nazareth
programme.sub-title: Homecoming - The Greatest Hits Live from Glasgow
programme.desc: Recorded Live at The Garage, Glasgow, October 20, 2001, this intimate performance includes most of the bands classics such as 'Razamanaz', 'My White Bicycle', and 'Hair of The Dog', and more recent songs including 'When the Light Comes Down' from their 1998 studio album Boogaloo.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Michael Brecker Band
programme.sub-title: Michael Brecker Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, decorated American saxophonist and composer Michael Brecker and his band played at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Accompanied by bassist Jeff Andrews, drummer Adam Nussbaum, pianist Joey Calderazzo, and guitarist Mike Stern, Brecker displayed his virtuosity in spades.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson Trio, Stuff Smith & Ella Fitzgerald
programme.sub-title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. The Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson and his trio of guitarist Herb Ellis and bassist Ray Brown are later joined by trumpeter Roy Eldridge and drummer Jo Jones. As an added attraction, American violinist Stuff Smith joins the proceedings. American singer Ella Fitzgerald, accompanied by pianist Don Abney, Ellis, Brown and Jones, hits her vocal peak in a stunning set that culminates in a jam session of It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing) with the entire ensemble.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Sarah Hicks, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir & Tuva Semmingsen
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone's iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono, and Bernard Herrmann. Soloists for this performance are Tuva Semmingsen (mezzo), Christine Nonbo Andersen (soprano), Hans Ulrik (saxophone) and Mads Kjølby (guitars). Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark in 2018.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No. 44 in E-minor, Vivier´s Lonely Child', Ligeti´s 'Lontano' and Death and Transfiguration by Richard Strauss.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg & Avery Amereau
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon, Gerard Causse, Iddo Bar-Shai & Jean-Jacques Kantorow
programme.sub-title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, in which Capuçon and violist Gérard Caussé appear as the soloists. Capuçon is then joined by pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï for a performance of Mozart's Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304. The program closes with Dmitri Shostakovich's Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a, which is a transcription of Shostakovich's String Quartet No. 8 by Russian conductor Rudolf Barshai, the composer's close friend. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 15, 2021.

Ягуарски хроники S1 E4 Сред бури, наводнения и прекъсвания на електрозахранването Лизи и ветеринарният лекар Жоарес се мъчат да поставят нашийници на повече ягуари. Срещаме нова женска, която екипът е нетърпелив да проучи.

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E3 Посещаваме дивите земи, където пустинята на Австралия се среща с горещия и враждебен Индийски океан, докато биоложката Лизи Дейли се гмурка с тигрови акули, манти и номадски костенурки.
Гладиатори S1 E4 В далечния север на Америка има области с реки, блата и крайбрежия. Животните тук са най-добрите бойци, тъй като те са елитът на природата и калени в битки воини.

Дивата Виена Виена е един от най-биологично активните градове в света; дивата природа процъфтява в нейните дворци, църкви и градини, а Донауинзел служи както за контрол на наводненията, така и за зона за отдих.

Екстремното речно предизвикателство на Стив Бакшал S1 E1 Стив Бакшал изследва река Балием на остров Нова Гвинея; той започва пътешествието си от езерото Хабема и се натъква на едни от най-екстремните бързеи, съществуващи на планетата.

Сан Андреас: надпревара с времето Разломът Сан Андреас е пресечна точка на две тектонични плочи, простиращи се през Сан Франциско и Лос Анджелис. Той е дълъг 1300 км и в момента е най-проучваният феномен в света.
Гладиатори S1 E1 Сухият сезон затяга хватката си върху малък водоем в голямата савана на Южна Африка; тук група гладиатори - големи и малки - са събрани в опасна близост.

Гладиатори S1 E2 Австралия е земя, отделена от другите от времето на динозаврите; изолирана в продължение на милиони години, еволюцията е превърнала нейните животни в най-впечатляващите гладиатори на планетата.
Гладиатори S1 E4 В далечния север на Америка има области с реки, блата и крайбрежия. Животните тук са най-добрите бойци, тъй като те са елитът на природата и калени в битки воини.

Хищници Срещата на хищник с плячка е драматично събитие в природата: за единия е храна, за другия - въпрос на живот и смърт. Показваме какви стратегии използват най-големите хищници, за да уловят плячката си.

programme.desc: 「宵夜係自願，收夜係被迫」 疫情後，相信全港打工仔都面對同一問題，一但OT收夜，在市面還有甚麼餐廳可以光顧？ 「宵夜」係你食飽之後的飯後甜品，「收夜」係捱完OT之後但咩都未食的人間悲劇。 為回應市民訴求，Jacky, Arvin 化身「收夜的美食家」，走訪香港各區晚上9點後依然熱鬧營業的各式餐廳，讓各位觀眾知道即使要OT或收夜，除左連鎖店的漢堡薯條，仲可以選擇中式、日式、美式、韓式，港式飲茶鑊氣小炒通通都有！ Jacky Fan及Arvin曾傲棐除了會介紹這些「收夜」餐廳的美食之外，也會訪問這些小店老闆了解他們的故事之餘，亦有嘉賓好友作為飯腳！ 除「收夜」餐廳美食介紹之外，也會有小環節介紹主持們的神秘食法，讓大家可以快速方便吃到一個有溫度兼好味道的Late Dinner！

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: People who grew up in the Chicago area in the 1960s and '70s are likely familiar with the characters of Bozo the Clown, Garfield Goose and Ray Rayner, who were staples on their respective children's programs on WGN during that period. This annual holiday special provides a look back at the shows that featured the popular characters -- various incarnations of "Bozo's Circus," "Garfield Goose and Friends" and "Ray Rayner and His Friends." Also included are three animated shorts that have aired on WGN for many years -- "Hardrock, Coco and Joe: The Three Little Dwarfs," "Suzy Snowflake" and the 1954 version of "Frosty the Snowman." WGN's Dean Richards hosts.

Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Sprova e familjes
programme.desc: Doan, një kirurg i suksesshëm që ka shpëtuar shumë jetë, por nuk ka mundur të shpëtojë të tijën. Ai u largua nga familja, nga dhimbja, nga kujtimet. Por disa plagë nuk shërohen kurrë. Çalla, një avokate e fortë, e vendosur dhe një grua që nuk i frikësohet së vërtetës. Kur familja bëhet sprova më e madhe, Doan duhet të zgjedhë: Të largohet apo të përballet me të vërtetën. Dhe në hije një armik që pret momentin e tij, Behram, një emër që sjell frikë dhe hakmarrje.

programme.title: Shqipëria Live
programme.desc: Programi ku perfshihen te gjitha tematikat kryesore te momentit. Te ftuar te ndryshem, intervista ekskluzive, lidhje direkte dhe debat ne studio. Nje mbulim 360 grade i ngjarjeve ne kohe reale, gjithcka qe ndodh ne vendin tone. Nje nga shtyllat kryesore te programit eshte larmishmeria e perfshirjes te figurave te ndryshme qofte ne studio por edhe nga terreni. programme.title: S0E3 - 6 Motrat
programme.desc: Në mes të dëshpërimit, motrat Silvia vendosin t’i gjejnë paratë në mënyrë jo ligjore. Gabrieli i ofron Fransiskës të këndojë te kafe-teatri ”Ambigu”.

programme.title: Ftesë në Pesë
programme.desc: Programi i pasdites në Top Channel, është një program sa informues aq edhe argëtues që ndërthur intervista, aktualitet, histori njerëzore dhe tema që prekin jetën e përditshme. Me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, personazhe publike dhe njerëz me histori frymëzuese, programi sjell biseda të sinqerta, emocione, debat dhe këndvështrime të ndryshme mbi çështje sociale, kulturore dhe të aktualitetit, në një atmosferë të ngrohtë dhe komunikim të drejtpërdrejtë me publikun.

programme.title: Per’Puthen
programme.desc: Eshtë një program që vendos në qendër njohjet, flirtin dhe marrëdhëniet mes të rinjve që kërkojnë dashurinë. Djem dhe vajza, që njihen me njëri- tjetrin në ekran, për të përmbushur qëllimin e nje dashurie, të ndërtuar në sytë e publikut. Takimet, pëlqimet, xhelozitë, rivalitetet dhe debatet krijojnë dinamika të papritura, ndërsa historitë e personazheve zhvillohen natyrshëm përpara publikut.

programme.title: Fiks fare
programme.desc: Programi i pare investigativ ne median shqiptare fokusuar ne korrupsionin e padrejtesite, trafikimin e abuzimet me pushtetin, problemet ekonomike, sociale si dhe hallet e ndryshme te njerezve. Fiks Fare trajton problematikat e qytetarëve, denoncon abuzimet, korrupsionin dhe shkeljet institucionale, duke i sjellë ato në vëmendjen e publikut dhe autoriteteve.

programme.title: Top story
programme.desc: Top Story është programi kryesor i debatit dhe analizës në Top Channel, i cili trajton çështjet më të rëndësishme të aktualitetit politik, ekonomik, social dhe ndërkombëtar. Përmes intervistave ekskluzive, debateve me të ftuar, analizave dhe raportimeve të thelluara, programi ofron një pasqyrë të plotë të zhvillimeve që ndikojnë në jetën publike.

programme.title: S1E4 - Në mbrojtje të Xhejkobit
programme.desc: Chris Evans. Bazuar në romain best seller të ”New York Times”. Kur i biri adoleshent akuzohet për një krim që tronditi gjithë qytezën, prokurori Andi Barber detyrohet të zgjedhë mes betimit për të mbështetur drejtësinë dhe dashurisë së pakushtëzuar të një babai.

programme.desc: Familja Krouli e shërbëtorët e tyre ne Downton Abbey ne rrezik per te ardhmen, në ankth për ardhjen e Methju Kroulit, trashëgimtarit të supozuar. Karsoni poshtërohet nga përballja me të kaluarën e tij.

Çdo episod sjell një grup personazhesh të njohur nga fusha të ndryshme, të cilët nisen drejt një destinacioni të ri dhe përfshihen në aventura jashtë përditshmërisë së tyre.

Piktura, skulptura, antikuarë e cdo vepër arti e një cilësie të vecantë mund të bëhët pjesë e programit. Përmes bashkëpunimit me koleksionitë, artistë dhe menaxherë arti vijne ne program ekspozitat dhe veprat me te mira te artisteve shqiptare dhe koleksionisteve te ndryshem.

Histori suksesi të mjekëve tanë më të mirë, anembane Shqipërisë. Këshilla, te rejat më të fundit të shkencës ne mjekësi, mite e të vërteta.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: Mientras investigan el robo de un camión, los detectives Mac Taylor y Stella Bonasera descubren un cuerpo aplastado bajo diez toneladas de acero.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: Cuando unos pandilleros jóvenes asesinan al dueño de una lujosa tienda de vinos en el Bronx, el equipo de CSI debe trabajar para encontrar evidencias que vinculen a alguien con el crimen.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: Un festejo por la publicación de un informe sobre corrupción policial termina en un derramamiento de sangre, cuando suenan disparos en el piso 65 de un rascacielos de Midtown.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: El detective Mac Taylor y Stella Bonasera descubren a una mujer muerta entre las sábanas sucias de una lavandería industrial.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: El asesinato en la violación del domicilio de un estudiante universitario envía a los detectives tras la pista de china blanca, heroína sin cortar que ha caído en las manos equivocadas.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: Un sospechoso armado es descubierto en una escena de crimen protegida. La investigación de rutina se convierte en una persecución a pie a través de los túneles del metro de la ciudad de Nueva York.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: Los detectives descubren que la investigación de una víctima de homicidio vehicular entra en colisión con un aficionado de los Medias Rojas, encontrado muerto en un estacionamiento.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.sub-title: Lo que ves es lo que ves

programme.title: CSI: New York en español

programme.title: CSI: New York en español

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: Es un caos en el zoológico del Bronx. Mac, Danny y la nueva CSI Lindsay Hamilton investigan la muerte de un hombre arrojado a los tigres.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: Un hombre encontrado muerto a golpes en el festival de San Genaro conduce a Mac y Stella de los callejones de la calle Mott a los poderosos operadores de Wall Street.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: Mac, Stella y Lindsay descubren por qué arrojaron a una joven bailarina con un billete de lotería ganador en el bolsillo desde el teleférico del puente de Roosevelt Island .

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: La testigo de un brutal asesinato en un ascensor ha desaparecido y, mientras los CSI la siguen, descubren el mundo de las lolitas de Manhattan.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: El detective Mac Taylor y el teniente de CSI Miami Horatio Caine siguen la evidencia desde la calurosa Miami a la acerada Nueva York mientras se acercan a Henry Darius.

programme.title: CSI: New York en español

programme.title: CSI: New York en español
programme.desc: En un hospital de muñecas de Nueva York, Mac y Danny recuperan el cadáver del doctor de muñecas bajo cientos de partes de cuerpos –partes de cuerpos de muñecas.

programme.title: Rock of Love: Bitter Suite
programme.desc: Bret surprises the final four with a trip to Las Vegas. One girl's lies cause Bret to question her intentions toward him.

programme.title: Rock of Love: Rockin the Rents
programme.desc: Bret wants to know more about the three remaining girls, and what better way to get the 411 than moving their parents into the house!

programme.title: Rock of Love: Brets Rock of Love
programme.desc: Bret takes his final two girls south of the border to spend some quality, romantic time with each one before making his final choice.

programme.title: Rock of Love: The Reunion
programme.desc: Tonight Bret and all of the girls reunite to rekindle the friendships and rivalries that made the house such a unique place.

programme.title: Rock of Love: The Clip Show
programme.desc: A look back at the outrageous and funny moments that never made the show.

programme.title: I Love New York: Let's Do It Again
programme.desc: New York must eliminate 5 men, but it's not that easy. At a pre-elimination cocktail party, things heat up as the men drink too much, fight and even bribe others to win over New York.

programme.title: I Love New York: Flowers from Fishburne
programme.desc: Now down to 15 men, New York invites the guys to a pond where they must prove their love by swimming to her and presenting her with a gift.

programme.title: I Love New York: The Stolen Date
programme.desc: With 12 guys left, some of the boys play a prank on a few of the less popular men that keeps them up all night.

programme.title: I Love New York: Nobody Likes a Snitch
programme.desc: New York has barely wiped the morning out of her eyes when a fight breaks out between two of her boys. Although NY can be a tolerant person, violence is non-negotiable and she is faced with the tough decision to let a guy go.

programme.title: I Love New York: Blood Oath Gone Bad
programme.desc: After snitching, fighting, and spitting, and nearly getting eliminated, one man is the house enemy and anxiously waits for an opportunity to redeem himself.

programme.title: I Love New York: Nip/Suck
programme.desc: New York surprises the guys with the return of one man. Another man is unhappy as his world is suddenly turned upside down and he literally fears for his life.

programme.title: I Love New York: I Still Have Love for New York
programme.sub-title: I Still Have Love for New York
programme.desc: New York invites the remaining six guys' exes to the house and this time, there's a special twist involved. She's bringing two of HER exes, Chance and Real, to help dig up some dirt on her guys.

programme.title: I Love New York: Mind Games
programme.desc: With 5 guys left, New York wants to find out who's the most compatible with her and who's just plain crazy, when she takes the boys for a psych test.

programme.title: I Love New York: Meet the Parents
programme.desc: With only four guys left, it's time to clean house, literally. New York has invited some special guests-the guy's parents, so she gets her boys to scour and scrub her house for their arrival.

programme.title: I Love New York: Miami Thrice
programme.desc: After the last elimination, New York tells her final three men to pack their bags because they're heading to Miami!

programme.title: I Love New York: Clip Show
programme.desc: In this 30-minute special episode, NY hosts a look back at hilarious, never-before-seen moments with our favorite guys from the series.

programme.title: I Love New York: Rasta Finale
programme.desc: After a season of ups and downs and a tense elimination in Miami, it's down to New York's final two suitors. They accompany New York to the tropics of Jamaica for the final showdown.

programme.title: Flavor of Love: Casting Special
programme.desc: From twins to super freaks, peep the girls vying for Flav's heart.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Mark and Steve return home from a fishing trip to a shocking discovery - the bloody and beaten body of Mickey, the young medical student who, along with his wife Jill, also a medical student, had been house-sitting for them.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Steve reluctantly goes on a dating game show and wins. Much to his pleasnat surprise, his date appears to be everything he's looking for and more.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Steve gets an unexpected phone call from Hawk, an old friend from the police force who has recently retired and moved into the Sunny Meadows rest home.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Marine Lt. Hank Thomas enters BBQ Bob's, the favorite lunchtime hangout of the doctors, wielding a gun in his left hand and threatening three other Marines who are already there.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Paraplegic, asthmatic game show contestant Sol Singer climbs into his specially-modified van and sets out to a TV studio where he is bout to compete on the live quiz show "Through the Roof."

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Dear friend and famous pop singer Danielle Marsh comes from new York to stay with Mark and Steve while she prepares for a big comeback conecrt.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: The murder of a young woman brings Alex into contact with her roommate Amy Saroyan, Alex's former girlfriend whom he has not seen in many years.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: While a deliriously happy Madison helps new love Brett Hayward move in with her, Steve investigates the brutal slaying of palastic surgeon Dr. Yordsberg.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Roger and Lana's marriage is rocky at best. Lana plots for her lover to kill Roger while he is away for the night on business so that she can have all of his money.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: While driving, David tells his wife Laura that he wants a divorce. Laura becomes hysterical and begins to cry and hit him. Trying to fight off his wife's attacks, David loses control of the car and flies into an intersection.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Jim, the hospital janitor, teaches Dr. Sloan some magic tricks. Jim is a whiz at magic and can nimbly manipulate a medallion between his fingers.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: George, a schizophrenic homeless man, shows up on a beach prophesizing about death. The couple in the nearby beach apartment, Cynthia and Ethan, threaten to call the police.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: When Steve Sloan is hospitalized for injuries sustained in a high-speed car chase, he wakes in a haze and watches with a blurred vision what looks like another patient being stabbed by one of the medical staff in his room.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Nurse Stacy Bradshaw tells Dr. Sloan about her skydiving escapades, and he politely turns down her extreme thrill-seeking invitation to come along.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Dr. Travis catches Dr. Sloan in his office, settling in with a bowl of popcorn to watch a reality television show, "Hot House," a "Big Brother" and "Real World" type series.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.sub-title: All Dressed Up And Nowhere To Die

programme.title: About the War
programme.desc: A reflection on war, on what the human being is capable of doing and on the job of reporter at the front. Fourteen years after recounting the conflict that shook Lebanon in 2006, Gianluca Grossi returns to the Land of the Cedars to confront a question that, over time,has become increasingly cumbersome: «What have I been used for? What is my job for? ».

programme.title: Milan, Everyone At Home
programme.desc: It’s a hot Sunday in March in Milan, when Claudio Rizzotti, freelance filmmaker, decides to take his camera to document what is beginning to happen around him. It is the beginning of the Italian lockdown for the Covid 19 pandemic and so his city, his friends and his family sink into a long lethargy.

programme.title: Cries from Syria
